note: Edges use existing atlas nodes probability and montecarlo only where real; compound-interest is a new concept id.

description.zh: 利息也生利息使钱按倍数增长 A = P(1+r)ᵗ；计息再细也趋近上限 P·e^{rt}；翻倍时间约 72/r 年；把未来的钱折现 PV = FV/(1+r)ᵗ；定期存入与贷款是同一规则的两个方向。固定利率模型，不含通胀、税费，非投资建议。
description.en: Interest that earns interest makes money grow by multiples, A = P(1+r)ᵗ; finer compounding approaches the ceiling P·e^{rt}; doubling takes about 72/r years; future money is discounted by PV = FV/(1+r)ᵗ; regular saving and loans are the same rule run in two directions. A fixed-rate model without inflation or fees, not financial advice.

label.zh: 把确定的账换成随机的账
label.en: From a certain ledger to a random one

reason.zh: 复利假设利率确定；真实回报有波动时，可以用大量随机抽样估计终值的分布，这是蒙特卡洛的典型用法。
reason.en: Compounding assumes a certain rate; when real returns fluctuate, many random draws can estimate the distribution of the final value, a typical use of Monte Carlo.

label.zh: 风险让期望不等于全部
label.en: Risk means the expected value is not everything

reason.zh: 确定利率下终值只有一个数；回报有波动时需要同时看平均和方差，同样的平均增长率下波动越大，复利终值越低。
reason.en: At a certain rate the final value is a single number; with fluctuating returns you need both the mean and the variance, and for the same average return more volatility lowers the compounded result.

title.zh: 为什么越早开始存钱越划算？
title.en: Why is it so much better to start saving early?

ask.zh: 利息也生利息，钱是按加法长还是按倍数长？同样利率，早 10 年和晚 10 年差多少个翻倍周期？
ask.en: Interest earning interest — does money grow by addition or by multiples? At the same rate, how many doubling periods does starting 10 years earlier buy?

ask.zh: 如果用随机模拟算很多条未来路径，早开始的优势是每次都出现，还是只在平均意义上？
ask.en: If you simulate many random future paths, does the early starter's advantage show up every time, or only on average?

reveal.zh: 复利按倍数增长 A = P(1+r)ᵗ，时间在指数上，早开始多滚几轮，差距是指数级的；翻倍时间约 72/r 年。
reveal.en: Compound growth multiplies, A = P(1+r)ᵗ, with time in the exponent — starting earlier adds compounding rounds and the gap grows exponentially; doubling takes about 72/r years.
